reviewer_actions.new_files_only: Two immutable JSON+Markdown independent review pairs

external_process_constructor_crosscheck.process_order: Reviewed frozen source performs Popen, waits and validates each result before starting the next; recorded process starts and execution end records are consistent with this order
external_process_constructor_crosscheck.live_proc_limit: Root reported live /proc confirmation when running. This review checked immutable external Popen/process/execution receipts after completion; it did not assert a post-exit /proc identity.

recomputation_method.stand_speed_height: Multiply original native per-scene mean by original frames, sum and divide by pooled frames. Each stand is 4 replicas x 500 frames. This recomputes unit conversion and weighting; sparse trace cannot independently reconstruct every 50 Hz native metric sample.
recomputation_method.four_fallen: Count actual true_success==1 and failed==1 in complete native ended ledger; crosscheck native diagnostics, 4 ended replicas and original metric episodes/successes/failures per scene. Denominator includes failures.
recomputation_method.prefix: Compare stored numeric JSON position/velocity/omega/gravity/height at common sparse trace timestamps while each lane is active and strictly before the earliest non-null first BLEND timestamp across that comparison. Never-blended lanes compare common active samples through terminal. This is sampled physical prefix equality, not bitwise solver state proof.

candidates.quiet_interpretation: No nominal command-defined quiet window is recorded. Zero frames/zero-valued means do not demonstrate stopping quality.
